summary: Repair (external AI guardian finding T3-RO-TOOLS-001, BLOCKING): the reviewer's read-only confinement used --allowedTools, which only AUTO-APPROVES tools and does not restrict availability (confirmed via Claude Code CLI reference + claude-code-guide). The mutating tools were still available, defeating the core safety property. Fix: REVIEWER_ADAPTER now uses --tools Read,Grep,Glob,Bash (restrict available set), --disallowedTools Edit,Write,MultiEdit,NotebookEdit (hard deny), --permission-mode dontAsk (headless deny-by-default), keeping --allowedTools only to auto-approve the read ops. Regression test rewritten to assert the ACTUAL restriction contract (mutators absent from --tools, present in --disallowedTools, dontAsk mode) rather than absence from --allowedTools. 252 unit + shell + validate green.
